verdict.rationale: Durable workflow execution is a fair question for a cloud deployment platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents workflows-as-code, durable execution, or built-in queues and retries. Persistent cloud-agent machines, instant rollbacks, and replica scaling are adjacent features, not durable workflow orchestration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy durable, long-running workflows as code without manually wiring queues and retries
